items.title: George Wein interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: George has performed and recorded with a long list of jazz luminaries, including Ruby Braff, Stephane Grappelli and Buck Clayton.

ctx.x: George Wein was born in Boston on October 3, 1925. He has made an indelible mark in the jazz world as a pianist, record producer, club owner and founder of the Newport Jazz Festival. George has performed and recorded with a long list of jazz luminaries, including Ruby Braff, Stephane Grappelli and Buck Clayton.
His talent in organizing jazz events is legendary and his formation of Festival Productions will assure that quality festivals will be available to jazz lovers here and abroad for many years to come.
